Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft marketplace addendum + billing routing questions

Thanks — quick read attached with line-by-line notes. Summary of legal position:
- We should avoid language that makes Redwood liable for CloudBridge's marketplace transaction fees. If CloudBridge wants the buyer to pay fees directly, that is fine; we can accept a pass-through model, but we must not assume responsibility to collect or remit fees unless we have contractual indemnity and reimbursement provisions.
- Any remit model where Redwood acts as a collection agent will pull in payment/process risk and likely require changes to our MSA (payments agent clause + KYC/AML covenants).
- Refund/chargeback language: we should require the marketplace seller (CloudBridge) to handle chargebacks originating from their marketplace and provide Redwood notice and reimbursement obligations only if the chargeback is due to Redwood's error.

I redlined suggested edits in CB_Marketplace_Addendum_CloudBridge_Redlines_v1.docx and flagged two clauses for commercial review: section 3 (fee allocation) and appendix B (reporting cadence).

-Marcus

Attachment: RBW_Marketplace_Addendum_Marcus_Notes.docx
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 10:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft marketplace addendum + billing routing questions

Looping in ops implications after quick sync with billing:
- If Redwood remits marketplace fees on CloudBridge's behalf we need: (a) daily metering export to our finance team, (b) netting rules (how we show fees on invoices to buyers), and (c) reserves for potential chargebacks — that will require a change to cash recognition and might delay payouts by 30–45 days.
- Preferred option from a systems simplicity standpoint: CloudBridge invoices the buyer directly for marketplace fees (pass-through). We can provide consumption reporting to support reconciliation but should not be the payment intermediary.
- If commercial team insists on remit model, estimate: 3–4 weeks of engineering + billing config to add remit flow, plus an ops playbook for dispute handling.

I attached a short diagram of the billing flow and a checklist.

Attachment: RBW_Billing-Flow-Diagram.pdf

—Vanessa

Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft marketplace addendum + billing routing questions

James / Elena — thanks for the draft and patience while we reviewed. Short answers up front:
1) Redwood prefers a pass-through model where CloudBridge invoices buyers directly for marketplace fees; Redwood can supply consumption exports and a monthly reconciliation report.
2) We cannot act as fee remitter without a separate payments addendum and changes to the MSA (Marcus can scope the legal changes).
3) Chargebacks: recommend marketplace seller (CloudBridge) owns chargebacks; Redwood will reimburse only where Redwood is demonstrably at fault and upon prior written agreement.

Next steps:
- Marcus will circulate a redline that preserves CloudBridge's commercial intent but removes agent/remit obligations from Redwood.
- Vanessa will draft an ops annex that describes required reporting (daily export, monthly reconciliation) and the estimated implementation timeline if remit is chosen.
- Priyom will coordinate with CloudBridge to confirm whether they can accept the pass-through approach and to prioritize any payments addendum if they cannot.

Can you confirm by end of week whether CloudBridge can switch to pass-through? If not, we will need a firm decision by next Wednesday so we can scope engineering/finance work for a remit path.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
